coordinate_system: top-left origin; +x right; +y down; sprite wheel centers are local to the 1000x360 body canvas

clean_generated_body.status: visually tuned against the generated body; minor caliper/axle deviations remain in generated artwork

customization.radius_behavior: scale any compatible wheel art to diameter = 2*nominal_radius_px before rotating
customization.rotation_source: use vehicle wheel angular velocity for each wheel independently
customization.stationary_hardware: brake calipers, swingarm, chain and forks remain on body layer; any rotating sprockets must be authored separately

notes: Profiles are not interchangeable: wheel anchors depend on which body art is selected.
The generated body has hand-tuned aligned centers; it is not a physically exact reconstruction of the axle/caliper positions.
A customized wheel may need rotor/caliper adjustment to avoid overlap, especially for different rim shapes.
